answer: Audits are recorded in kernel, queued in signal, and reef publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 67 identities per epoch. A farm of 241 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 2705 identities would post 569 proofs and burn roughly 57 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
